findings.description: Retained VAL02 includes density and MATERIAL channel bulk density; VAL03 includes product mass/residue and MASS evidence. Enumerated DEF02/03 scope does not explicitly identify density/product-mass coverage or a controlled crosswalk. No actual evidence was deleted. Residue is also retained under REQ22; duplication is not required.
findings.required_action: Explicitly map each retained quantity to a controlled definition scope item/cross-reference, or justify any exclusion through independent review and actual user authority. No new numerical threshold/calculation is requested.

findings.description: DM03 phrase «предусмотреть отсутствие результата при неполной выдаче» is ambiguous. Absence of product/measurement must not mean omission of failed/incomplete cycle or disposition record. Other retained scopes/schema preserve those records; no actual data loss demonstrated.
findings.required_action: Clarify retained cycle/product outcome, quality/missing reason and failed/incomplete disposition even when product/measurement is absent; link the full-series accounting schema before method/program approval.
